name: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Gulf Shores
description: Enjoy a fabulous stay on the Gulf of Mexico when you make a reservation at our Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Gulf Shores hotel. Our location on Highway 59 is just three miles north of the Gulf beaches. We offer comfortable, affordable accommodations whether you are with us just one night, or are planning to stay and enjoy the area. Start your morning right with a free continental breakfast and stay connected with free WiFi. Cool off in the outdoor pool and keep your clothes fresh with guest laundry facilities. Our suites are equipped with a microwave, refrigerator, and wet bar. Accessible accommodations are also available. Discover exotic animals, enjoy a sunny day on the beach, or play mini-golf. Spend a sunny afternoon on the beautiful sugar-white beaches and emerald green waters of Perdido Beach. Encounter more than 300 animals, including lions, tigers, bears, monkeys, and macaws at the Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo. For big thrills, go-karts, and miniature golf, be sure to head on over to the Track Family Recreation Center.
